text:
eval-bot: nightly-evals finished for rwd-3.2.1-quant4 — failures detected
- summarization-suite: -7.8% quality vs baseline
- codegen-fewshot: -4.3%
- safety-checks: false-positive rate +0.9%
report: https://internal/reports/1790004321

mira: seeing the alert. assigning triage. initial severity estimates: summarization=P0, codegen=P1, safety=P2. Owners: @aj (oncall), @kevin (model owner), @olga (evals), @julie (data/support). @aj can you take immediate mitigation?

aj: oncall here, taking ownership of mitigation. any recent model or infra deploys?

kevin: rolled quant4 packing into rwd-3.2.1 yesterday 03:15 UTC (small perf/size tradeoffs). no infra deploys. suspect quantization instability on long-context summarization prompts.

olga: pulling failing prompt samples now — will post a short sample set.

julie: grabbed two quick examples from support logs, showing truncation + hallucination. posting inline: 
```
Prompt: "Summarize the Q3 earnings for Redwood Inference including guidance."
Baseline (fp16): "Redwood reported 32% Y/Y revenue growth and maintained guidance; no acquisitions announced."
rwd-3.2.1-quant4: "Redwood Inference announced acquisition of DataX and posted a loss; guidance withdrawn."
```

mira: yikes. that looks like a clear regression for summarization.

aj: recommendation — immediate rollback of production summarization routes to rwd-3.2.1-fp16 and enable canary to validate. I'll start rollback and update status.

kevin: acknowledged. I'll prepare a patched quant profile after rollback (possible fix: reduce per-channel clip and re-run calibration).

olga: spinning an eval job to re-run summarization suite vs fp16/quant4 on a 100-prompt stratified sample. ETA ~20m. job id: eval-job-1790004321-1

eval-bot: eval-job-1790004321-1 started (re-run comparison), ETA 18m. results will be posted to the report link.

mira: action items (owners):
1) @aj — rollback and mitigation (P0)
2) @kevin — produce quant-stability patch + bench (P1)
3) @olga — extended evals, failing-prompt buckets, triage report (P1)
4) @julie — check support/customer reports & user impact (P2)
Please update this thread when you start/finish.

aj: starting rollback now. posting timeline and ETA shortly.

kevin: FYI tagging infra for possible GPU eviction impacts during rollback: @infra-oncall

julie: searching support queue for matching hallucination reports, will DM if customer visible incidents found.

aj: rollback applied to canary at 1790004500, canary checks passing, rolling to 50%. monitoring latencies and token-cost delta.

mira: thank you. marking triage state = in-progress. We'll reconvene if canary doesn't improve metrics.

olga: initial failing buckets uploaded: https://internal/olga/failing-buckets/1790004321 — buckets: long-financial-summaries, nested-quote-parsing, multi-doc-merge.

kevin: opening branch fix/quant-stability-1790. plan: reduce asymmetric quant clipping + recalibrate using extended calibration set (include long summarization prompts).

aj: monitoring logs; if we see re-spikes we'll escalate codegen to P0 as well.

mira: thanks everyone — please post short status updates here (start/finish for each action). I'll schedule a brief sync if results from eval-job are mixed.

olga: eval-job-1790004321-1 progress: 40% complete, initial diffs concentrated in long-financial-summaries.

kevin: compiling quick local reproduce; will attach a small reproducible test later.

aj: rollback reached 100% at 1790004702, baseline metrics restored on summarization routes; continuing post-rollback monitoring.

mira: good initial outcome. leaving thread open for results from extended eval and quant patch.

kevin: ETA on patch candidate build ~3h, will link CI artifacts here.

olga: final eval results posted to report (summary): quant4 still worse on long-financial-summaries by ~6.9% — flagging for follow-up.

julie: no high-severity customer incidents found in the last 24h matching hallucination signatures.

aj: monitoring dashboards; alerts quiet for now. will escalate if anything changes.

mira: closing initial triage (state: triage-in-progress) — follow-ups owned by @kevin/@olga for patch + verification. reopen if new alerts.

end of thread.
